Merchant Admin Console

All admin circuits require the merchant's private signing key as a ZK witness for authorization. The key is never transmitted — only the derived commitment is verified on-chain.

Admin Circuits
setMerchantCommitment(Uint<32>)
Anchor merchant authority + set threshold
revokeMembership(Bytes<32>)
Revoke a fraudulent commitment (ZK auth)
resetProgram(Bytes<32>, Uint<32>)
Reset loyalty program + threshold
incrementSession()
Bump session nonce (replay protection)
🔑 Panel 1 — setMerchantCommitment(Uint<32>)

Anchors the merchant's public commitment on-chain and sets the minimum loyalty tier point threshold.

🚫 Panel 2 — revokeMembership(Bytes<32>)

Revoke a specific reward commitment. Requires merchant authority proof via merchantSigningKey() ZK witness. Revoked commitment stored in lastRevokedCommitment.

🔄 Panel 3 — resetProgram(Bytes<32>, Uint<32>)

Reset the active loyalty program to a new ID and update the minimum point threshold. Bumps session for clean epoch boundary.

🔒 Panel 4 — incrementSession()

Bumps the activeSession nonce to invalidate stale proofs from previous epochs.
